QF.id: IV Introduction to Interest Rate Derivatives_24

question.text: Which of the following is a key advantage of exchange-traded derivatives over OTC derivatives?

explanation.text: The Logic: Exchange-traded derivatives offer settlement guarantee through the clearing corporation, which acts as central counterparty (CCP). This eliminates counterparty credit risk — a major advantage over OTC where credit risk exists. The Trap: OTC offers greater customization (not exchange). Exchange-traded products have MORE regulatory oversight. Larger notional sizes are typically easier in OTC markets. Cross-Exam Context: The trade-offs between exchange and OTC derivatives are tested in Series IV and apply across all derivative asset classes. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Post-2008 financial crisis, regulators globally pushed for more OTC derivatives to be centrally cleared, recognizing the benefits of CCP guarantee in reducing systemic risk.
